title: BitGo publishes USD1 launch infrastructure announcement
description: BitGo announced its infrastructure and custody partnership for World Liberty Financial's USD1, describing the token as fully U.S.-dollar backed and redeemable 1:1.
notes: Primary BitGo launch material plus current USD1 terms.

title: JPYC Inc. begins issuance and redemption of JPYC
description: JPYC Inc. began issuing and redeeming the Japanese-yen JPYC electronic payment instrument through JPYC EX on Avalanche, Ethereum and Polygon.
notes: Official JPYC launch release and official contract-address warning.
